kcpr_operational_expansion_note: B1.6 operational expansion only; NOT a historical repo expansion. The acronym KCPR is used but never expanded anywhere in the repo.
purpose: Defines how the existing varna polarity table is rendered into poles for the B1.6 Symbol-U generative scaffold, without any per-target pole selection. Conservative dual-pole rendering: each supported consonant-varna shows BOTH poles of each axis it contributes to, plus the candidate table's signed lean; the generator is never told which pole is 'correct'.

polarity_axes.role: named positive_pole / negative_pole per axis (dual-pole source); leak_risk=low

varna_four_sphere_lexicon.role: companion four-sphere lexicon (not required for pole rendering)

governing_rules.role: KCPR framed as a decoder-side pole-selection rule; kosha condition experimentally assigned, not from a lexicon

phoneme_to_varna_bridge.role: supplies which consonant varna keys are reachable (25/34); vowels VOWEL_NO_PROFILE; f/z/zh UNSUPPORTED_NO_VARNA

pole_rendering_rule.per_varna: for each axis the varna contributes to, render BOTH named poles of that axis; mark the table's signed lean (worldly/binding pole = the pole matching the sign; liberating/counter pole = the opposite); show axis id and source files.
pole_rendering_rule.sign_convention: +1 -> worldly/binding pole = axis positive_pole; -1 -> worldly/binding pole = axis negative_pole (per track_g source_basis = vrtti binding-sense).
pole_rendering_rule.leak_control: only low-leak axis pole NAMES are used; per-varna vrtti gloss 'notes' (high leak_risk) are NOT sent to the generator/judge.
pole_rendering_rule.asymmetry: if only one pole is available for some reason, the asymmetry is recorded explicitly; poles are never fabricated to balance.

example_ka.note: Rendered from track_g axis_contributions + track_g_polarity_axes pole names. Illustrative; unvalidated candidate representation; not evidence.

scaffold_impact.csr_stl_frame: DEFERRED / REMOVED until a frozen CSR/STL rulebook is separately created

randomized_control: must randomize the varna->profile association (per the frozen randomization seed) but preserve the IDENTICAL KCPR dual-pole rendering FORMAT, so format is not a giveaway.
